user_request: Recover biologically grounded, spatial hypotheses from library/datasets/dataset.h5ad under withheld-background constraints, then execute tests to classify each hypothesis as SUPPORTED, REFINE, or DROPPED.

provenance.justification: This plan directly adapts the hypothesis_recovery_withheld template: Step 1–2 correspond to the Coding/CellVoyager exploratory phase producing exploration_log.md and data_inventory.tsv; Step 3–5 implement the Hypothesis and Critic agents’ drafting, review, scoring, and finalization into hypotheses.json with quality_scores and hypothesis_brief.md; Step 6 implements the Coding/Reporter testing phase, generating test_results_phase3.json and updating hypothesis statuses (SUPPORTED/REFINE/DROPPED) and the brief. The plan explicitly fixes the dataset path (library/datasets/dataset.h5ad), respects the no-subsampling and no-PDF/no-gold-claims constraints, and adds an explicit CellVoyager-consideration step in line with the benchmark instructions.

steps.title: Summarize background and inventory dataset
steps.description: Read the limited background from outputs/briefs/paper_summary.txt and load the full library/datasets/dataset.h5ad (no subsampling of cells/spots). Inventory tissue, technology, spatial coordinates, annotation fields, conditions, and basic QC/spatial structure, and record initial OBSERVATION entries describing major patterns.
steps.reasoning: A structured understanding of what the dataset contains (axes, annotations, spatial layout) is necessary to constrain plausible hypotheses and ensure later tests are feasible and grounded in the available data.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step requires reading a local summary file and programmatically inspecting an AnnData (.h5ad) object to inventory metadata, QC, and spatial structure; the coding_agent is designed for direct Python/R interaction with spatial/single-cell data and file I/O.

steps.title: Run autonomous exploratory spatial analysis
steps.description: Perform deeper exploratory analysis of spatial organization, expression patterns, neighborhoods, and condition/region contrasts on the full AnnData, preferably via cellvoyager_agent (or document and use an alternative if more appropriate). Capture candidate spatial phenomena as OBSERVATION and OBSERVATION_CV entries and, if CellVoyager is used, serialize its structured suggestions.
steps.reasoning: Autonomous exploration (especially via CellVoyager when used) can reveal non-obvious spatial patterns and complementary viewpoints, reducing blind spots compared with manual exploration alone.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step explicitly calls for autonomous exploratory spatial analysis on a full AnnData with a brief background, which matches the CellVoyager agent’s core capability (iterative hypothesis-free exploration and notebook-generation), so it is preferred over manual coding here.

steps.title: Draft structured, testable hypotheses
steps.description: Using the exploration_log.md (including any OBSERVATION_CV entries) and data_inventory.tsv, formulate approximately three biologically grounded, spatial hypotheses. For each, define a clear natural-language statement, link to supporting OBSERVATION IDs, and specify an initial structured test_plan describing data subsets, metrics, and statistical approaches. Save these as drafts.
steps.reasoning: Explicit, observation-linked hypotheses and test plans ensure that downstream analyses are hypothesis-driven rather than purely exploratory and that each claim can be operationalized on this dataset.
steps.assignment_rationale: Formulating structured, testable hypotheses and initial test plans from the exploration_log and data inventory is the primary function of the hypothesis_agent, making it the most suitable for drafting biologically grounded spatial hypotheses.

steps.title: Critically review and score drafts
steps.description: Have a critic agent review each draft hypothesis for biological plausibility, non-circularity, confounders, and clarity. Assign preliminary quality_scores for derivable, novel, feasible, specific, and falsifiable, and record detailed critique and suggested refinements for each hypothesis.
steps.reasoning: Systematic critique and scoring help filter out weak or ill-posed hypotheses and improve the remaining ones before committing computational resources to full testing.
steps.assignment_rationale: This step requires systematic critique of hypotheses—checking for non-circularity, confounders, plausibility, and assigning quality scores—which is exactly the remit of the critic_agent.

steps.title: Finalize hypotheses and analysis plans
steps.description: Revise the draft hypotheses using the critic’s feedback, finalizing a small set of high-quality hypotheses. For each, define a precise hypothesis statement, detailed test_plan executable on the full dataset, and finalized quality_scores (derivable, novel, feasible, specific, falsifiable), with an initial status such as PLANNED. Summarize them in a human-readable brief.
steps.reasoning: A finalized, machine-readable hypotheses.json with explicit quality metrics and executable test plans, plus a concise narrative brief, provides a clear contract for what will be tested and why.
steps.assignment_rationale: Refining and finalizing hypotheses and executable analysis plans based on critique, while assigning final quality scores and producing a narrative brief, aligns with the hypothesis_agent’s strength in structuring and articulating testable biological hypotheses.

steps.title: Execute tests and narrow hypothesis statuses
steps.description: Run each hypothesis’s test_plan on the full library/datasets/dataset.h5ad without subsampling cells/spots, performing the specified spatial/statistical analyses (e.g., neighborhood enrichment, spatial gradients, condition contrasts). For each hypothesis, record test statistics, effect sizes, and key visual/quantitative outputs, and update its status to SUPPORTED, REFINE, or DROPPED with narrowing_notes. Aggregate all results into a structured JSON and refresh the brief to reflect final evidence.
steps.reasoning: Executing the pre-specified tests and mapping results back onto each hypothesis is essential to turn speculative ideas into supported, revisable, or rejected claims, completing the withheld-background recovery benchmark.
steps.assignment_rationale: Executing the finalized test plans on the full AnnData, computing spatial/statistical metrics, and updating hypothesis statuses requires flexible programmatic analysis of spatial transcriptomics data, which falls squarely within the coding_agent’s capabilities; no more specialized agent fits better for this implementation step.
